Definition
[pinching set] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0153, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0154 1. ch11:11.59\group Ricci Flow Pinching A subset $Z\subset \mathcal A_n$ is a pinching set if it is closed, convex, $O(n)$-invariant, preserved by $\dot R=Q(R)$, and there are $\delta >0$, $K<\infty $ such that \[ \left|R-\frac{\operatorname {tr}(R)}N I\right| \le K|R|^{1-\delta }\qquad (R\in Z). \]
